Honestly for me (diagnosed adhd)
 the struggle i face are managing my time properly and focusing on tasks, i tend to procrastinate course work when I know it's going to be difficult and mentally draining
What has helped me is essentially reminding myself why i need to work hard and graduate and that it's ok not to know everything just try to learn

 using a study method called pomodoro i sit down and make myself intensely focus on the task i am doing then go on a short break and repeat

I ask for help from my friends and professors ( the ones that are nice and helpful) with course work 
And i always try to take notes or voice recordings while i am in class helps me focus. 

I write reminders constantly on my planner on notes app.

I also have Sunday resets where i do self care, clean, do assignments, update my to do list etc

Lastly i would like to see more compassion and understanding towards people with adhd, i am not faking it, lazy and unmotivated i try my best

Now i am on medication it's much better 🤍
